# Liquid chrome

Sculptural metallic highlights on a near-black field.

## Use

Use for premium product showcases, title moments, and creative launch cards.

## Essential traits

- Silver sculptural accents
- Matte text panel
- Near-black negative space

## Typography

System sans-serif with sharp heading hierarchy.

## Layout and surfaces

Minimal composition, metallic edge accents, restrained reflectivity. Brushed and polished chrome decorations around matte reading surfaces.

## Palette

- background: #111315
- surface: #202426
- text: #f7f8f8
- muted: #c0c8cd
- accent: #d8e1e7
- border: #76858e
